# EmulationTheoryObserver

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neuromorphic disturbance observer that uses internal predictive models to emulate the environment's dynamics, enabling real-time disturbance estimation without explicit analytical models. This provides a bio-plausible framework for robust control in neuromorphic systems, crucial for adaptive behavior in dynamic network environments.
